WITH pattern_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    `ANA Pattern`,
    AVG(`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg
  FROM Examination
  WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`
),
cross_pattern_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as overall_avg
  FROM pattern_averages
),
above_average_patterns AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.`ANA Pattern`,
    pa.avg_acl_igg,
    cpa.overall_avg
  FROM pattern_averages pa, cross_pattern_avg cpa
  WHERE pa.avg_acl_igg > cpa.overall_avg
),
above_avg_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as mean_of_above_avg
  FROM above_average_patterns
)
SELECT 
  `ANA Pattern`,
  avg_acl_igg,
  avg_acl_igg - overall_avg as above_cross_avg,
  avg_acl_igg - (SELECT mean_of_above_avg FROM above_avg_mean) as from_above_avg_mean
FROM above_average_patterns
ORDER BY `ANA Pattern`
